subject: general
question: Who among the following female singers has been felicitated with the Bharat Ratna?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Lata Mangeshkar**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Lata Mangeshkar** is the only female singer among the options who has been felicitated with the **Bharat Ratna**.
 
• The Bharat Ratna is the **highest civilian award** of the Republic of India, instituted in **1954**.
 
• It is awarded in recognition of exceptional service/performance of the highest order, without distinction of race, occupation, position, or sex.
 
• Other notable recipients of the Bharat Ratna in the field of arts include **M. S. Subbulakshmi and Bhimsen Joshi**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Lata Mangeshkar** was awarded the Bharat Ratna in **2001**.
 
• She is widely considered one of the greatest and most influential singers in India.
 
• Her career spanned over seven decades, and she recorded songs in over **thirty-six Indian languages**.
 
• The Bharat Ratna medallion is shaped like a peepal leaf and carries an image of the sun along with the words "Bharat Ratna" inscribed in Devanagari script.
